video_title: LIVE: Pelicans vs. Jazz Postgame Interviews 11/4/2026

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the Pelicans' resilience and grit
quotes.excerpt: It ain't always going to be pretty but we're going to find a way to get it done.
quotes.quote: We had to get it out the mud in that one. It wasn't pretty. We couldn't throw it in the basket. We missed stops, turnovers. It wasn't a pretty game early. What I've said, and I'll say it to the guys, we talk about representing this city. It ain't always going to be pretty but we're going to find a way to get it done with the resilience and grit. That's what it was for us and to find a way throughout the game.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley on the Pelicans grit after a tough win: We had to get it out the mud in that one. It was not pretty but we are going to find a way to get it done with the resilience and grit.

structured.context: Head coach Jamahl Mosley reflects on the team's resilience and grit during a difficult game against the Jazz.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley praises T-Wat's energy and toughness
quotes.excerpt: His spirit, his energy, his joy for the game, his joy for his teammates was incredible.
quotes.quote: My hat goes off to T-Wat. He doesn't show up in the stat sheet with a lot of numbers, but T-Wat was incredible. His spirit, his energy, his joy for the game, his joy for his teammates and that gritty toughness that he brings is fun to watch. It's fun to watch him play the way he supports our guys, the way he represents this team and what we're about.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley praises T-Wat for his impact beyond the box score: My hat goes off to T-Wat. He does not show up in the stat sheet with a lot of numbers, but T-Wat was incredible.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley praises the energy and toughness brought by T-Wat despite his limited statistical output.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on defensive communication and slip-outs
quotes.excerpt: We screwed up the switches and that was one of the things that we talked about.
quotes.quote: We screwed up the switches and that was one of the things that we talked about in the huddle before going into overtime. They put George in it, then they put Markkanen in it, slip-outs, not setting the screen. We miscommunicated a couple and we've been burned on those before. That's also the great part about being in and experiencing it before in other teams. You can talk about what you need to clean up, but we've got to get better at that because they are a tremendous slip-out team.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley admits the Pelicans need to improve their defensive communication: We screwed up the switches. We miscommunicated a couple and we have been burned on those before because they are a tremendous slip-out team.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley discusses defensive communication errors made against Keyonte George and Lauri Markkanen during the game.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the defensive challenge for his best player
quotes.excerpt: Being the face and the best player on the team, your ability to take on all matchups.
quotes.quote: That's the challenge for him. That's what we've tasked him to do. Being the face and the best player on the team, your ability to take on all matchups any given time. When he sits down and guards like that, and they're leading the league in steals, that says something. That's the commitment, that's the buy-in to know that defensively we're getting the job done. When he does it, it's a ripple effect and that's why he has been what he's been because he's doing whatever is necessary right now to get us over the hump.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley on the defensive expectations for his star player: Being the face and the best player on the team, your ability to take on all matchups any given time. When he sits down and guards like that, that says something.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley discusses the defensive expectations and leadership role placed upon the team's best player.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the bench energy and selflessness
quotes.excerpt: There's support, there's care factor, there's selflessness of saying I'm just going to celebrate my teammate.
quotes.quote: That went back to him. The guys were feeding him and if you watch the energy on the bench when he was going, that's what I love to see. There's support, there's care factor, there's selflessness of saying I'm just going to celebrate my teammate. And that brings energy to not only him, but to the team, to the crowd. That's big for us and he was selfless. He's trying to make the play. Even that pass over the top that he made down the stretch, he was trying to make the right play.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley on the Pelicans bench energy: If you watch the energy on the bench when he was going, that is what I love to see. There is support, there is care factor, there is selflessness.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley highlights the selfless energy and support shown by the bench players during the game.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on defense sustaining the team
quotes.excerpt: Your defense allows you to stay in these games.
quotes.quote: Defense. Said it before, say it after, I'll say it a lot of times. Your defense allows you to stay in these games. So now down the stretch when you've got to make your free throws, you make your free throws, you go 90% from the free-throw line because you gave yourself a chance by defending. You saw what it was in the first half, it was a rock fight. And the ability to stay with it the entire time tells you that your defense will sustain you and then you put it together down the stretch.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley emphasizes the importance of defense: Your defense allows you to stay in these games. You saw what it was in the first half, it was a rock fight. Your defense will sustain you.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley emphasizes how defensive consistency allowed the team to stay in the game and succeed down the stretch.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the intensity and spirit of his player
quotes.excerpt: There's such a care factor and intensity and a spirit and a joy about who he is.
quotes.quote: He just cares. There's such a care factor and intensity and a spirit and a joy about who he is and what he means to this team. He's the first one in training camp that was barking and talking and going, getting guys going and riled up. He's a tenacious defender. He is a spirit. I can't say enough about his energy and his spirit and what he provides to this team. And we need that from him. And again, he was going from playing none to in rotation. And that's the beautiful part about this team is that you just don't know.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley on a player earning rotation minutes: He is a tenacious defender. I cannot say enough about his energy and his spirit and what he provides to this team. He was going from playing none to in rotation.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley discusses the intensity and spirit of a player who has recently moved into the rotation.
